mapper.select: INSERT INTO sys_task_execution (tenant_id, execution_key, status, lease_owner, lease_until, attempt_count, started_at, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{executionKey}, 'RUNNING', #{leaseOwner}, now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}::int), 1, now(), now(), now(), 0) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, execution_key) WHERE delete_flag = 0 DO UPDATE SET status = 'RUNNING', lease_owner = EXCLUDED.lease_owner, lease_until = EXCLUDED.lease_until, attempt_count = sys_task_execution.attempt_count + 1, started_at = now(), finished_at = NULL, last_error = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE sys_task_execution.status != 'SUCCESS' AND sys_task_execution.attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND ( sys_task_execution.lease_until IS NULL OR sys_task_execution.lease_until < now() ) RETURNING sys_task_execution.attempt_count
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_task_execution SET status = 'FAILED', finished_at = now(), last_error = #{lastError}, lease_until = NULL, updated_at = now() WHERE delete_flag = 0 AND status = 'RUNNING' AND lease_until < now() AND attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts}
